what: Seven blaze-cli tests stopped with `the toolchain shelf's cfg row for aarch64-apple-darwin has no panic atom (blaze-world unit_panic)`. cost: a lane; the tests were red on the tree before and after the night's changes
cause: each test file wrote its own copy of the target's cfg atoms instead of one row shaped as the cut writes it
whys: fixture::shelf takes the atoms from its caller; the row's shape (which atoms the cut always writes) has no type or shared constant; a new reader of the row (Cuts::read) made an atom required without a check that every fixture row carries it
class: a test fixture's hand-written copy of a record field drifts from what the real writer puts there
prevention: done in blaze-cli: one `tests::SHELF_CFG` row with the panic atom, used by both shelves. Wanted: blaze-world's fixture (or blaze-toolchain's record writer) to require the panic atom in a cut row, so a row without it cannot be written at all; blaze-world tests.rs and list_tests.rs still pass rows without it
state: fixed in blaze-cli, uncompiled; the writer-side check is open
